title: Choose a new password
body: This replaces the old one immediately. Nothing else about the account changes.
length_rule: At least {count} characters. A sentence you can remember beats a short one you cannot.
sessions_note: Every other browser and phone signed in to this account is signed out. Calls in progress are not interrupted.
reused_title: This is one of your last five passwords
reused_body: The server keeps the fingerprints of recent passwords so an old one cannot come back. Choose one you have not used here before.
done_title: You can sign in with the new password
done_body: The code has been used up and will not work again. Other sessions on this account were signed out.
offline_title: This browser cannot reach your Tel-Agent server
offline_body: No response from {host}. Your calls are unaffected if the machine is still running — this is a network problem between you and it. Check that you are on the business network or connected to the VPN.
expired_note: This reset has expired or was already used.
